sessionTitle: Build persistent and scalable AI agent memory with TiDB

announcements.name: Hybrid retrieval with RRF in one query
announcements.shortDescription: Vector and keyword searches run against the same table and are combined with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, so rows ranking high in both lists win
announcements.longDescription: TiDB performs real hybrid search by combining two searches with a ranking step on top: one common table expression runs a vector search to grab the top 10 rows by meaning, while a second runs a keyword search to grab the top 10 by exact word match. The results are merged using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), so rows that rank high in both lists win. In the demo, asking about dietary restrictions returns the peanut allergy row first because it scores well in both the vector and keyword searches, all in one query against one database with no separate engines to keep in sync.

announcements.name: Native Azure OpenAI integration
announcements.shortDescription: TiDB connects directly to an Azure OpenAI deployment for embedding generation
announcements.longDescription: TiDB offers a native Azure OpenAI integration so users can easily connect their Azure deployment for embedding generation. This is presented alongside getting-started resources, including spinning up a free TiDB starter cluster at TiDB.com that is ready within 30 seconds with no credit card.

announcements.name: Scale-to-zero and database branching
announcements.shortDescription: Idle agents incur no cost, and an isolated database can be spun up per agent in milliseconds
announcements.longDescription: TiDB provides scale to zero, meaning idle agents literally cost nothing and you only pay for the requests you actually run, so bursty traffic produces a bursty bill. It also offers database branching, letting you spin up an isolated database per agent in just a few milliseconds so every agent gets its own workspace separated from everyone else. Additional capabilities mentioned include resource control to cap each workload and fast scale-out, since compute and storage are separated so capacity can be added in seconds.

announcements.name: Python SDK `pytidb`
announcements.shortDescription: Installable via `pip install pytidb`, providing hybrid search and RRF in a few lines
announcements.longDescription: TiDB offers a Python SDK for Python developers, installable via "pip install pytidb". It provides hybrid search and RRF in three lines of code.

announcements.name: MCP server and agent rules for AI coding tools
announcements.shortDescription: Published for Cursor and Claude users to integrate TiDB into coding workflows
announcements.longDescription: For Cursor and Claude users, TiDB provides an MCP server along with a bunch of agent rules available on GitHub at github.com/pinkapp/agentrules [inferred]. These let developers drop TiDB directly into their AI coding workflow.
